title: corymbia ellipsoidea
intro: Corymbia ellipsoidea, commonly known as the Large-fruited Bloodwood, is a species of tree in the family Myrtaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as its ability to aid in wound healing and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Corymbia ellipsoidea include analgesia, anti-tumor activity, and immunomodulation, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents present in Corymbia ellipsoidea include flavonoids like quercetin and kaempferol, phenolic acids like caffeic acid and ferulic acid, and terpenoids like limonene and pinene.
